description: Exact-configuration review sections for race investigation and trials. A record fixes section bounds so a later recording is measured over the same distance. Labels are neutral unless a sourced turn map exists; a desired corner count is never a reason to invent a boundary.

records.provenance: Bounds are the analysis regions detected in the 2026-09-20 15:09 Toyota Supra Class B race recording. Detected regions 5, 6 and 7 are one corner by the driver's confirmation on 2026-09-22 and are merged here as section E across 77.5-86% lap distance. No official Bristol turn boundary is claimed.

records.layout: Oval (the recordings carry no TrackConfigName; the key uses the short name IRP)
records.provenance: Bounds derived from racing-line geometry (Lat/Lon curvature against LapDistPct) over 62 clean laps in six recordings from 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-23, with lift, brake and minimum-speed positions as supporting evidence. The lap is two corner complexes of about 180 degrees each, separated by straights that turn less than 3 degrees. Turns 1-2 and 3-4 name those complexes in lap order from the start/finish line; the entry/exit split is each complex's geometric mid-point, not an official turn boundary. Sections tile the lap except 0.5% either side of the start/finish line, because a section cannot wrap. Derivation: docs/05-quality/irp-review-sections-2026-09-24.md.
